title: Every Attacked Tanker Widens the Urals Discount
subtitle: Fewer tankers called at Novorossiysk after the strikes, and the discount on Black Sea Urals widened by 1.1 dollars to 26.6 dollars a barrel.

source.name: Platts assessments of Black Sea Urals differentials and Novorossiysk freight

data.label: Discount after the strikes
data.annotation: A wider discount is revenue surrendered on every barrel loaded.

supportingFacts.label: Increase in freight rates from Novorossiysk to India during July, as recorded by Platts.

metadata.keyFinding: The Black Sea Urals discount widened to 26.6 dollars a barrel as freight rose 14.6%.
